## Boundary checks

- [ ] No grade, course, project, learner, or application state entered the base map
- [ ] Stable IDs were preserved or lifecycle migration is documented
- [ ] Relationship direction and conditions were checked
- [ ] Copyrighted or private source material was not copied

## Validation

- [ ] `tools/validate-map`
- [ ] JSON Schema validation
- [ ] Relevant tests or visual checks

## Review dimensions requested

- [ ] mathematical correctness
- [ ] observability and granularity
- [ ] dependency necessity and alternatives
- [ ] representation and practice coverage
- [ ] accessibility and plain language
- [ ] provenance and licensing
- [ ] schema and graph integrity
